subject: Air freight FRA-SGN e-bike batteries
body:
Hello,

please quote Frankfurt (FRA) to Ho Chi Minh City (SGN), 30 cartons of e-bike batteries, 900 kg, 3.5 cbm, ready 27.11.2026, we deliver to FRA.

Please note: lithium ion batteries, UN 3480, class 9, packing instruction 965 section IA. Cheapest option, EUR.

Best regards
Daniel Roth
Logistics
Volta E-Bike GmbH
